description: AI-generated smart-home thermostat example: the formula blends thermostat, wall sensor, humidity, window state, and occupancy to estimate room temperature error in a normal household setting.
prediction_expr: thermostat_temp + round((room_sensor_temp - thermostat_temp) * 0.5) + round((measured_humidity - 50) / 20) - round(window_open * 0.8) + round(occupancy * 0.3)

room_sensor_temp.label: Wall sensor reading vs GT temp

thermostat_lags_during_draft.label: Thermostat lags while a draft is active
thermostat_lags_during_draft.condition: abs(col('Thermostat Temp (C)') - col('GT Temp (C)')) > 1.0 and col('Window Open') == 1

window_left_open_while_cold.label: Window left open while the room is cool
